title_en: People's Procuratorate of Baoying County, Yangzhou City, Jiangsu Province v. Liu Guoyi et al. — fraud
ruling_gist_en: A perpetrator who, knowing that the platform under their control is a virtual spot trading platform and that the funds injected by clients do not actually enter the spot trading market, obtains client funds by fabricating facts and concealing the truth, and takes possession of them, shall be found guilty of fraud.

full_text_en:
People's Procuratorate of Baoying County, Jiangsu Province v. Liu Guoyi et al. — fraud

【Ruling Summary】

Where an actor, knowing that the platform under his control is a virtual spot trading platform and that funds injected by clients do not actually enter the spot trading market, defrauds clients of their funds by fabricating facts and concealing the truth, the conduct shall be convicted as the crime of fraud.

Procuratorial Authority: People's Procuratorate of Baoying County, Jiangsu Province.

Defendant: Liu Guoyi, male, 52 years old, Han ethnicity, residing in Langya District, Chuzhou City, Anhui Province. He was criminally detained on December 1, 2013, for this case and arrested on December 20, 2013.

Defendant: Sheng Linghong, male, 41 years old, Han ethnicity, residing in Pudong New Area, Shanghai. He was criminally detained on December 1, 2013, for this case and arrested on December 20, 2013.

Defendant: Cai Zupeng, male, 24 years old, Han ethnicity, residing in Pudong New Area, Shanghai. He was criminally detained on December 1, 2013, for this case and arrested on December 20, 2013.

Defendant: Lyu Peng, male, 19 years old, Han ethnicity, residing in Pudong New Area, Shanghai. He was criminally detained on December 1, 2013, for this case and arrested on December 20, 2013.

The People's Procuratorate of Baoying County, Jiangsu Province, brought a public prosecution against the defendants Liu Guoyi, Sheng Linghong, Cai Zupeng, and Lyu Peng for the crime of fraud before the People's Court of Baoying County, Jiangsu Province.

The People's Court of Baoying County, Jiangsu Province, found the following facts at the first instance:

On August 19, 2013, the defendant Liu Guoyi registered and established Anhui Yinbaobao E-Commerce Co., Ltd. (hereinafter "Yinbaobao Company") in Chuzhou City, Anhui Province, under the name of Liu Qi. The company's business scope included: online sales of gold and silver ornaments (without engaging in value-added telecommunications or financial business) and investment management (the above business scope does not include items prohibited, restricted, or requiring licensing under national laws and regulations). On September 13, 2013, the defendant, in the name of Yinbaobao Company, paid RMB 60,000 to purchase the spot ordering system software, named "Yinbaobao Ordering and Recovery System," from Shenzhen Jinzhi Software Co., Ltd. The agreement signed between the parties expressly stated that the software was a virtual software, to be used only for simulated training, simulated trading, and legitimate transactions. The system was bundled with the third-party payment platform "Chongqing Yijifu."

Starting from October 2013, the defendant Liu Guoyi, knowing that the Yinbaobao Ordering and Recovery System was a virtual software, and that if clients operated on the system and injected funds, those funds would not enter the real silver trading market but would flow into the "Chongqing Yijifu" third-party payment platform and then be transferred to his personal account, hired the defendant Sheng Linghong as an analyst and business agent for Yinbaobao Company. He signed an agreement with Sheng Linghong stipulating that Sheng Linghong would develop clients, and Liu Guoyi would give him 75% of the handling fees and 70% of the clients' losses as commission.

The defendant Sheng Linghong, knowing that the Yinbaobao Ordering and Recovery System was a virtual software and that client funds did not actually enter the silver spot trading market, nevertheless instructed the defendants Cai Zupeng and Lyu Peng to develop clients. It was agreed that after receiving the handling fees and commissions from clients' losses from Liu Guoyi, he would share the proceeds with Cai Zupeng and Lyu Peng.

Between September 2013 and November 2013, the defendants Cai Zupeng and Lyu Peng developed the victims Liu Huagao and Cai Wanxue from Baoying County as clients. To obtain illegal gains, the two defendants fabricated identities, such as being salespersons of Shanghai Blackstone Private Equity Investment Co., Ltd. After gaining the victims' trust, and for the purpose of causing losses to the victims, the defendants Liu Guoyi and Sheng Linghong conspired to modify the maximum position holding quantity and the loss method of the Yinbaobao Ordering and Recovery System. On November 8, 2013, Cai Zupeng and Lyu Peng instructed Liu Huagao and others to use all the money they had for speculating in silver to buy silver, increasing the funds to over RMB 500,000. That evening, Cai Zupeng and Lyu Peng also performed a "double act," falsely claiming that Cai Zupeng had entered the trading room, and had Lyu Peng alone contact Liu Huagao by phone to convey the analyst's instructions, with the aim of shifting blame onto each other if the victims suffered losses. At around 9:15 p.m. that evening, when the two victims' accounts had made a profit of nearly RMB 100,000, Cai Zupeng and others intentionally prevented them from selling until the funds invested by the victims were lost, thereby defrauding Liu Huagao and Cai Wanxue of a total of over RMB 400,000. After the incident, Liu Huagao stated that the losses made it impossible for him to repay the borrowed money. Liu Guoyi paid Sheng Linghong RMB 100,000 to return to the victims. Sheng Linghong paid Cai Zupeng RMB 70,000 out of this sum, and Cai Zupeng actually returned RMB 40,000 to the victims.

The above facts were not disputed by the defendants Liu Guoyi, Sheng Linghong, Cai Zupeng, and Lyu Peng during the court trial, and are confirmed by the confessions of the four defendants; the statements of the victims Liu Huagao and Cai Wanxue; the testimony of witnesses Liu Qi, Gong Xiaofeng, Hu Tao, Chen Hao, Wei Xufeng, Li Jun, Xu Baoming, Yang Xiao, Chen Long, Xu Yufeng, Ge Bowen, Liu Zhengqi, Zhang Laikun, and Wang Zhian; the business license of the enterprise legal person; the sales contract; the cooperation agreement; the client agreement; the transaction details; the activation application form and attachments; the client fund flow details; the account opening materials and bank fund flow details; the call records; the identification笔录 and photos; the chat records; the case acceptance registration form; the case occurrence and arrest process explanations; the seizure and return of property lists; the letter of understanding; the audio and video recording discs; and household registration information, among other evidence. This is sufficient to establish the facts.

The People's Court of Baoying County held at the first instance:

The defendants Liu Guoyi, Sheng Linghong, Cai Zupeng, and Lyu Peng, with the intent of illegal possession, knowing that the controlled platform was a virtual silver spot trading platform and that client-injected funds did not actually enter the silver spot trading market, defrauded clients of their funds by fabricating facts and concealing the truth. The amount involved was huge, and their conduct constituted the crime of fraud. The defendants Liu Guoyi, Sheng Linghong, Cai Zupeng, and Lyu Peng jointly committed intentional crimes and played primary roles in the joint crime, making them all principal offenders. The defendant Liu Guoyi voluntarily surrendered after the crime and truthfully confessed the criminal facts, constituting voluntary surrender, and was given a lighter punishment according to law. The defendants Sheng Linghong, Cai Zupeng, and Lyu Peng truthfully confessed the criminal facts after being brought to justice, and were given lighter punishments according to law. Liu Guoyi and others have returned all the illicit gains and have obtained the victims' forgiveness, which may be considered as circumstances for a lighter punishment. The charges of fraud brought by the People's Procuratorate of Baoying County against the defendants Liu Guoyi, Sheng Linghong, Cai Zupeng, and Lyu Peng are clear, the evidence is reliable and sufficient, and the charges are established. The court supports this.

Regarding the defense opinions raised by the defense counsels for the defendants Liu Guoyi, Sheng Linghong, and Lyu Peng that the charges in the indictment were not established and that the case should be convicted and sentenced as the crime of illegal business operation: Upon examination, although Liu Guoyi registered and established Yinbaobao Company and purchased the Yinbaobao Ordering and Recovery System software in the company's name, he and Sheng Linghong concealed the truth that the Yinbaobao Ordering and Recovery System was a virtual software and that client-injected funds could not enter the silver spot trading market. They intentionally modified the system's trading methods. Lyu Peng and Cai Zupeng used false identities to fabricate facts, deceived the victims into trusting them, and intentionally obtained the victims' funds through virtual transactions, causing the victims to be defrauded of over RMB 400,000. The above conduct of the defendants meets the constitutive elements of the crime of fraud and should be convicted and sentenced as fraud, not as the crime of illegal business operation. Therefore, the above defense opinions are not adopted. Regarding the defense opinions of the defense counsels respectively for Liu Guoyi, Sheng Linghong, and Lyu Peng that Liu Guoyi had voluntary surrender, Sheng Linghong and Lyu Peng truthfully confessed the criminal facts after being brought to justice, the three defendants had good attitudes of admitting guilt, had no prior criminal record, returned all illicit gains, and obtained the victims' forgiveness, requesting a lighter punishment or a discretionary lighter punishment for the above defendants: Upon examination, these opinions have factual and legal basis and are adopted. Regarding the defense opinion of Liu Guoyi's defense counsel requesting a mitigated punishment and a suspended sentence for Liu Guoyi: Upon examination, the amount defrauded by Liu Guoyi exceeded RMB 400,000. Although he had the circumstance of voluntary surrender, given the specific circumstances of this case, it is not appropriate to apply a mitigated punishment and impose a suspended sentence. Therefore, this defense opinion is not adopted. Regarding the defense opinion of Sheng Linghong's defense counsel that Sheng Linghong played a secondary role in this case and should be found as an accessory: Upon examination, in the joint crime with Liu Guoyi and other defendants, Sheng Linghong developed clients to obtain illegal gains, provided advice for the victims' transactions, and conveyed instructions to the victims through Cai Zupeng, thereby defrauding the victims of their funds. He played a primary role in this case and should be found as a principal offender. Therefore, this defense opinion is not adopted. Regarding the defense opinion of Cai Zupeng's defense counsel that Cai Zupeng truthfully confessed the criminal facts, voluntarily admitted guilt, had no prior criminal record, returned the illicit gains, and obtained the victims' forgiveness, requesting a lighter or discretionary lighter punishment and a suspended sentence for him: Upon examination, although Cai Zupeng has the above statutory and discretionary circumstances for a lighter punishment, and a lighter punishment may be imposed on him, given the circumstances of this case, it is not appropriate to impose a suspended sentence on Cai Zupeng. Regarding the defense opinion of Lyu Peng's defense counsel that Lyu Peng played a secondary role in this case and should be found as an accessory, requesting a lighter or mitigated punishment and a suspended sentence for him: Upon examination, Lyu Peng intentionally caused the victims to increase their invested funds and played an active role in the process of defrauding the victims' funds. Therefore, he should be found as a principal offender, and this defense opinion is not adopted.

In summary, in accordance with Article 266, Paragraph 1 of Article 25, Paragraphs 1 and 4 of Article 26, Paragraphs 1 and 3 of Article 67, Article 52, Article 53, and Article 64 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China, and Article 1 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues Concerning the Specific Application of Law in the Handling of Criminal Cases of Fraud, the People's Court of Baoying County rendered the following judgment on April 30, 2014:

1. The defendant Liu Guoyi is convicted of the crime of fraud and sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of four years and a fine of RMB 80,000.

2. The defendant Sheng Linghong is convicted of the crime of fraud and sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of four years and a fine of RMB 80,000.

3. The defendant Cai Zupeng is convicted of the crime of fraud and sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of four years and a fine of RMB 70,000.

4. The defendant Lyu Peng is convicted of the crime of fraud and sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of four years and a fine of RMB 70,000.

5. The illegal gains of RMB 30,000 each from the defendants Sheng Linghong and Cai Zupeng shall be further recovered and confiscated to be turned over to the State treasury.

After the first-instance judgment was pronounced, Liu Guoyi and Cai Zupeng refused to accept it and appealed to the Intermediate People's Court of Yangzhou City, claiming that the case should be convicted and sentenced as the crime of illegal business operation. After the second-instance court accepted and docketed the case, the two persons voluntarily withdrew their appeals. The second-instance court ruled to permit the withdrawal of the appeals.

The first-instance judgment has become legally effective.
